#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: Department of Cabinet Affairs (Mantrimandal Karya Vibhag)

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: The undersigned is directed to say that the Members of the Council of Ministers shown in the attached list relinquished charge of their respective portfolios, with effect from the afternoon of March 24, 1977.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: 2. Shri Morarji R. Desai has been sworn in as Prime Minister by the Acting President at 3-30 P.M. today, 24 March, 1977. The Ministry of Home Affairs may kindly take such action as may be considered necessary regarding issue of Gazette notifications, etc.

#/texts/18.label: paragraph
#/texts/18.full_gt_text: Copy with a copy of the enclosure, forwarded to the Secretary-General, Lok Sabha Secretariat/Secretary-General, Rajya Sabha Secretariat, for information.
